content.short: AdaLink is a Cardano affiliate network connecting stake pools, projects, creators, and marketers online.
content.description: AdaLink is a blockchain-based affiliate marketing network built for the Cardano ecosystem. The platform connects stake pool operators, Cardano businesses, creators, influencers, NFT founders, and marketers so they can manage partnerships and promotional campaigns. By using blockchain tracking, AdaLink aims to make conversions and rewards more transparent for affiliates. Its purpose is to help pools and projects increase visibility, improve delegation campaigns, and coordinate growth with trusted community partners.
content.meta: AdaLink is a Cardano affiliate and creator-marketing network connecting projects, SPOs, and promoters. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
